name: Noritake Garden
description: An urban green space on the former Noritake china factory site near Nagoya Station, with the Noritake Museum, craft center, and garden paths.
highlights: The Noritake Museum and craft demonstrations
Garden paths on the former factory site
A short walk from Nagoya Station

en.name: Noritake Garden
en.description: An urban green space on the former Noritake china factory site near Nagoya Station, with the Noritake Museum, craft center, and garden paths.
highlights: The Noritake Museum and craft demonstrations

en.notes: The garden and museum are one coherent outing; admission to the garden is free with paid museum entry. The adjacent AEON Mall Nagoya Noritake Garden shares the site.

ja.name: ノリタケの森
ja.description: 名古屋駅近くの旧ノリタケ製陶所跡地に整備された都会の緑地。ノリタケミュージアムやクラフトセンター、庭園の散策路があります。
highlights: ノリタケミュージアムとクラフト体験
旧工場跡地の庭園散策
ja.notes: 庭園とミュージアムは一つの散策として楽しめます。庭園は無料、ミュージアムは有料です。隣接するイオンモールNagoya Noritake Gardenと同じ敷地です。
